scope: 16 missing Asia/Africa catalogue flags plus the intentionally unresolved Jeonnam–Gwangju successor symbol. Source files and dispositions only; root integrates lookup and attribution.
method: Cached current Commons metadata plus current official design/use sources. Bounded helper downloads with shared pacing/cooldown; no AI images or emblem-on-field flags fabricated. Copyright and separate official-symbol use conditions are distinct. Neutral holds are source/identity/use-scope gaps, not assertions that flags do not exist or are universally forbidden.
